name: Chieri (Italy)
description: Quartered: the first and fourth white with a red Greek cross throughout, the second and third red with a yellow lion rampant.
history: Municipal flag of Chieri, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: cross in the first and fourth quarters
lion rampant in the second and third quarters
